# KEMET VACATION

> Luxury tours, private Red Sea yacht charters, Nile cruises, VIP Cairo Pyramids access, and bespoke multi-day expeditions across Egypt. Based in Hurghada, Red Sea Governorate, Egypt.

## Destinations
- [Hurghada Tours](https://kemetvacation.com/city/hurghada): Red Sea yacht charters, scuba diving, snorkeling at Giftun Island, Dolphin House, and desert safaris.
- [Cairo & Giza Tours](https://kemetvacation.com/city/cairo): Private Pyramids of Giza, Sphinx, Grand Egyptian Museum, and Old Cairo tours.
- [Luxor Tours](https://kemetvacation.com/city/luxor): Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, Hatshepsut Temple, and sunrise hot air balloons.
- [Aswan Tours](https://kemetvacation.com/city/aswan): Philae Temple, Abu Simbel, Nubian villages, and Nile felucca sailing.
- [Alexandria Tours](https://kemetvacation.com/city/alexandria): Bibliotheca Alexandrina, Qaitbay Citadel, and Kom El Shoqafa Catacombs.
- [Sharm El Sheikh Tours](https://kemetvacation.com/city/sharm-el-sheikh): Ras Mohammed diving, Blue Hole Dahab, and Sinai desert excursions.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What is the best time to visit Hurghada?** Year-round. Best diving: March–November. Best weather: October–April.
- **Do I need a visa for Egypt?** Most nationalities can obtain a visa on arrival at Hurghada or Cairo airports.
- **Is Egypt safe for tourists?** Yes. Hurghada, Luxor, Cairo, and major tourist areas are well-secured for international visitors.
- **What currency should I bring?** USD, EUR, and GBP are widely accepted alongside Egyptian Pounds (EGP).
- **How fast do you confirm bookings?** All bookings are confirmed via WhatsApp within 2 hours.
